authority_path: fatal resource pressure creates a membership-level organizational tension
agents author executable laws over the constrained World API
the sandbox validates proposals against parent/evaluation constraints
current active members exercise majority-vote authority over valid laws

enactment_rule: valid proposals pass by majority vote in the democratic arms and are then executed in order

broader_g1_result.scope_note: This aggregate governance gain mixes multiple mechanisms and is not an S5-only effect.

result_scope_note: The direct S5 observation is limited to the membership/exile authority path. Catch caps, penalties, taxation, treasury disbursement and other operational laws are not credited as S5 merely because they are legislated.
provenance_note: The paper is the authoritative public result artifact recovered in this review. No authoritative public code repository/revision for GovSim-SelfGovern was recovered, so no unrelated GovSim repository is attached by name similarity.
vsm_interpretation: At the benchmark-defined society boundary, current members hold legitimate authority to ratify an executable membership rule; enactment changes membership and later rounds operate after that decision. This directly exercises S5 identity-policy authority for the composed benchmark society. The fixed sandbox, voting procedure, physics and API are benchmark/evaluation membrane constraints, and the result does not establish native S5 ownership or capability for any canonical Index harness or underlying model.
